name: Library Covers
description: Library cover images rendered from your own posters (tilted poster wall, title, item count), kept up to date automatically. Live TV gets a channel-logo wall.
overview: Library covers that stay up to date

versions.changelog: Books libraries: item count and cover wall; libraries of retro games managed by JellyEmu are counted as games ("11,056 games").

First public release. Covers for every library and for Live TV (channel-logo wall), automatic updates when items are added or removed, English settings page, cover labels in English or French (follows the server language).
